site.name: The Ibiza Connection
site.tagline: Private villas and island living, arranged by people who live here.
site.description: A hand-picked collection of private villas in Ibiza, with boat days, cars and concierge arranged by a local team in Santa Eulària. Price match guarantee: found it for less elsewhere? We'll match it.
site.whatsapp_message: Hello The Ibiza Connection, I would like to enquire about a villa.

pricing.note: Rates in the seasonal table are per night, in euros, for the villa only. Card prices are weekly starting rates. Cleaning, deposits and any extras are confirmed with your quote. We never add a booking fee.

footer.headline: Your Ibiza, arranged.
footer.note: Tell us who is coming, when, and how you like to spend your days. We will send back a shortlist of houses that fit — not a list of everything we have.
footer.legal: The Ibiza Connection is operated by Invenio Homes S.L. · NIF B16649519 · VAT ESB16649519 · Calle Molins de Rey 12, 07840 Santa Eulalia del Río, Ibiza, Baleares
